_comment_svg: No SVG is deployed. PNGs sit at predictable public paths, so the matching SVG path is the first thing anyone will try. This rewrites every .svg request to a path that does not exist, which makes Vercel answer 404 with a 404 status — not a 200 carrying an error page — regardless of what lands in the output directory later. An accidental commit therefore cannot expose paid artwork. The source is a regex group rather than `/:path*.svg`, because a path-to-regexp modifier followed by a literal suffix in the same segment does not match reliably.
_comment_library: Reserved for the gated library. /api/* is free for serverless functions; nothing is built there yet. The grid renders from manifest.json, so a gated route can read the same manifest at request time and serve signed URLs without changing markup or CSS.
